point_to_point.route: Guwahati to Tawang cab (420 km)
point_to_point.range: MakeMyTrip Tawang city page, cab class not stated, plus 867 taxes and charges

taxi_day.basis: ONE Cabs (onenortheastcabs.in, article published 3 Mar 2026, updated 24 Aug 2026) quotes a daily Tawang package of 5,000 per day, cab and driver for the day with no meter. Cross-checks: Staz Travel Diary (23 Apr 2026) paid 4,000 for a Day-1 local sightseeing cab in Tawang; Thrilling Travel (29 Mar 2025) quotes about 5,500 for a private cab on the Bum La and Madhuri Lake circuit. Median of 4,000, 5,000 and 5,500 = 5,000.
taxi_day.notes: No taxi union rate card was found online. ONE Cabs publishes a WhatsApp number but no street address. Tour Babari (22 Aug 2025) gives a much lower 2,500-3,500 for Bum La taxis and 500-1,500 per day for local cabs; treated as an outlier. Outside cabs are not allowed to do local sightseeing in Tawang (union rule), so operators arrange local vehicles.

food_per_person_day.basis: Cost for two midpoints: TravelTriangle (page updated 28 Aug 2024) Yangke's Cafe 400, Dragon Restaurant 200-400, Northeast Flavours 300-400, Dharma Coffee House 400-600, Phun's Cafe 600-800, Chotton Restaurant 400-500, Taste of Tawang 400-600; Holidify (undated) Orange Bar & Restaurant 300, Dragon Restaurant 350. Standard = 3 meals x median of all nine midpoints (400) / 2 = 600. Budget = 3 x median of the four cheapest (Orange 300, Dragon 300, Dragon 350, Northeast Flavours 350 = 325) / 2 = 488, rounded to 490.
food_per_person_day.notes: Source prices are 2024 or older and undated respectively; expect current prices to be higher. No thali or momo menu prices found.
